headline: AppleCare+ monthly and annual rates increase for new Mac and iPad plans
summary: Apple has quietly raised the prices for its extended warranty service for Macs and iPads. The new rates apply to new customers.
details: Apple has increased the monthly and annual rates for its AppleCare+ service for new Mac and iPad customers. This change was quietly implemented and reported by Bloomberg.
The exact price increase varies depending on the specific Mac or iPad model. This marks a notable shift in Apple's pricing strategy for its extended warranty service.
AppleCare+ provides extended warranty coverage, including accidental damage protection, for Apple devices. The service has been a significant revenue stream for the company.
This price adjustment comes as Apple continues to expand its product lines and services. Customers purchasing new Macs or iPads will now face higher costs for this added protection.
caption:
AppleCare+ monthly and annual rates have increased for new Mac and iPad plans.

Apple has increased the monthly and annual rates for its AppleCare+ service for new Mac and iPad customers. This change was quietly implemented and reported by Bloomberg.

The exact price increase varies depending on the specific Mac or iPad model. This marks a notable shift in Apple's pricing strategy for its extended warranty service.

AppleCare+ provides extended warranty coverage, including accidental damage protection, for Apple devices. The service has been a significant revenue stream for the company.

This price adjustment comes as Apple continues to expand its product lines and services. Customers purchasing new Macs or iPads will now face higher costs for this added protection.
